assertions.text: The note is a file under notes/ named YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>.md, the slug three words at most
assertions.evidence: changes.json lists one added file, `notes/2026-10-08-search-index-postgresql.md`. It sits under notes/ and has the YYYY-MM-DD prefix, which is today's date. The slug `search-index-postgresql` is three words.

assertions.text: The note opens with a frontmatter holding status: draft
assertions.evidence: The file starts with `# Move the search index to PostgreSQL`, then `Date: 2026-10-08`. It has no `---` frontmatter block and no `status: draft` anywhere.

assertions.text: The note's first line is its `# ` title
assertions.evidence: Line 1 is `# Move the search index to PostgreSQL`.

assertions.text: The note closes with a ## Next section that names Alice and the schema migration
assertions.evidence: The last section is headed `## Next steps`, not `## Next`. Its only item, `Alice migrates the schema next week (week of 2026-10-12).`, does name Alice and the schema migration, and the section is last. The expected output specifies a `## Next` section, and the heading differs from it.

assertions.text: Each line of the ## Next section opens with who does it, then a colon, as `Alice: …`
assertions.evidence: The section is `## Next steps`; its line `- Alice migrates the schema next week (week of 2026-10-12).` opens with Alice, but no colon follows the name.

assertions.text: No file is written outside notes/

claims.claim: The folder was an empty repo with one "base" commit and no existing notes
claims.evidence: The transcript's `ls -la` shows only `.git`, and `git log` shows a single commit, `f962723 base`.

claims.claim: The note is at notes/2026-10-08-search-index-postgresql.md, using today's date
claims.evidence: changes.json and the outputs/ path match. Today is 2026-10-08.

claims.claim: The note records the decision, the reason and the next step (Alice migrates the schema next week)
claims.evidence: The file has Decision, Why and Next steps sections with that content.

claims.claim: "Next week" was read as the week of 2026-10-12 and that date was written in
claims.evidence: The note says `(week of 2026-10-12)`. 2026-10-08 is a Thursday, so the next Monday is 2026-10-12.

claims.claim: The note adds nothing the user did not say (no current store name, PostgreSQL version or migration details)
claims.evidence: The note has only the decision, the reason, and Alice's migration, plus the date and the computed week. It names no store, version or migration details.
